name: Proton Drive Backup
author: gabrielharfield
description: Proton Drive panel using a specific, pinned build of the official Proton Drive CLI as the transfer backend (downloaded once to this plugin's own folder and version-checked on every launch — never the system/AUR copy, never "latest"; see the README for why). The Backup tab is Deja-Dup-style: pick a file or folder, it's uploaded to /my-files/Backups with the current date and time baked into its name (never overwritten), and any previous backups of that same item are offered for deletion first. The Browse tab is a breadcrumb-navigable read/write view of your whole Proton Drive, starting at /my-files, to download any file or folder or upload one into whatever folder you're currently viewing. No sync, no file comparison anywhere — every action is an explicit, one-shot upload or download; see the README for why real-time multi-device sync isn't offered. Left-click the bar icon to open the panel — the panel isn't IPC-toggleable (manageIpc is off, to avoid duplicate-instance IPC target collisions on multi-monitor setups).

barWidget.description: Bar icon that opens a panel to back up files/folders to Proton Drive, and to browse, download from, or upload to your Drive. Sets up its own pinned CLI automatically on first use.
